name: Tray Collapse Popup 托盘折叠
description:
把 AppIndicator 托盘图标收进一个点开才出现的浮层弹窗（类似 Windows 的溢出区）：淡入淡出、鼠标离开自动收起、外观可视化调节（不透明度/底色/圆角/留白）、右键胶囊打开设置。基于 fnidore/tray-collapse 修改。需要 AppIndicator 扩展。

Collapse AppIndicator tray icons into a floating popup with fade animation, auto-hide on pointer leave, and adjustable appearance. Fork of fnidore/tray-collapse.
